# Sources — what each input claims, and on whose authority

**Generated by `sources.py`. Do not edit by hand** — edit the register and
re-run, or the citation and the model will disagree without saying so.

`CALIBRATION.md` explains how the constants were *recovered*. This file
records what each one *asserts about the world*, and what would falsify it.

## Status vocabulary

| Status | What would falsify a claim carrying it | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `gate` | re-derived by the validation gate on every run | 9 |
| `sourced` | a primary, openly reachable publication says this | 24 |
| `observed` | an official statistic, cached with its period | 5 |
| `assumed` | a modelling choice with a rationale and no external authority | 17 |
| `fitted` | solved backwards from a published result; no independent content | 1 |
| `unverified` | traceable to a source we could not open - a live to-do | 3 |

**Audit:** clean — 59 inputs, every parameter field covered, every quoted value equal to the value the model runs on.

These rest on a document nobody on this build has opened. They are not
wrong; they are unchecked, and nothing quoting them should be presented
as sourced.

Confirm against a subscription — open item 6.

## What no open source can supply

- **EUA price series.** Sets the price path, the drift mu and the volatility sigma. sigma is the only pure threshold lever, so this is the highest-value input left unsourced. No free feed reached: Ember's API 404s, Sandbag publishes no CSV. Needs ICE, EEX or Refinitiv.
- **Commercial hydrogen assessments.** Delivered hydrogen prices are licensed (Platts, Argus). Eurostat bounds them from below via the power bill; it cannot pin the level.
- **Per-plant reline dates.** Would replace the calibrated age0 = 14 with real campaign ages and turn the fleet surface into a named target list. Plant-level campaign starts are not published as a series.

## Bibliography

- **`diw2082`** — [DIW Berlin DP 2082 — Revisiting Investment Costs for Green Steel](https://www.diw.de/documents/publikationen/73/diw_01.c.901039.de/dp2082.pdf), DIW Berlin. DRI-EAF capex €600–1000/t₂₀₂₂; the 25-year / 8% lifetime-and-interest pairing behind CRF(25, 8%); EU-27 fleet of 26 BOFs at 112 Mt/yr.
- **`tk_schwelgern`** — [First campaign ends after 21 years — Europe's biggest blast furnace to be modernized](https://www.thyssenkrupp-steel.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/first-campaign-ends-after-21-years-europes-biggest-blast-furnace-to-be-modernized.html), thyssenkrupp Steel. Campaign life between relines; Schwelgern ran 1993–2014 and its reline exceeded €200m.
- **`salzgitter_reline`** — [Salzgitter's Relined Blast Furnace](https://agmetalminer.com/2024/01/10/salzgitter-relined-pig-iron-furnace/), MetalMiner. BF A reline at €100m over >2 Mtpa ⇒ €50/t capacity.
- **`gem_capex`** — [Steel plant construction cost](https://www.gem.wiki/Steel_plant_construction_cost), Global Energy Monitor. Integrated BF-BOF ≈ $1,100/t installed.
- **`son_capex`** — [Capital investment costs](https://www.steelonthenet.com/resources/capital-investment/capital-investment-costs.html), steelonthenet. Corroborates the BF-BOF installed-cost range, $1,000–1,200/t.
- **`ieefa_reline`** — [European steel technology transition in danger of slowing](https://ieefa.org/resources/european-steel-technology-transition-danger-slowing-carbon-capture-not-answer), IEEFA. ~26 Mtpa relined since 2020; ~12.7 Mtpa facing a reline decision 2030–2035. This is the calendar age0 = 14 has to land inside.
- **`ieefa_h2dri`** — [Hydrogen unleashed: the evolving H2-DRI-EAF pathway beyond 2024](https://ieefa.org/resources/hydrogen-unleashed-opportunities-and-challenges-evolving-h2-dri-eaf-pathway-beyond-2024), IEEFA. EU H₂-DRI-EAF capacity 2.5 Mt (2025) → 15–20 Mt (2030): the 43–52%/yr band gamma is fitted inside.
- **`agora_steel`** — [Achieving climate-neutral steel by 2050](https://www.agora-industry.org/fileadmin/Projekte/2024/2024-28_IND_Green_Iron/A-IND_382_Achieving_climate-neutral_steel_by_2050_WEB.pdf), Agora Industry. ~45 Mt net-zero-compatible DRI by 2030; corroborates the growth band.
- **`zoe_idb`** — [How the Industrial Decarbonisation Bank can complement the ETS](https://zoe-institut.de/en/news/how-the-industrial-decarbonisation-bank-can-complement-the-ets/), ZOE Institute. €100bn Industrial Decarbonisation Bank, €30bn Investment Booster.
- **`ec_ccfd`** — [Guidance on Carbon Contracts for Difference (July 2026)](https://competition-policy.ec.europa.eu/document/download/42330cc4-d31e-41cf-ae35-3db7ab933331_en?filename=20260717_guidance_on_carbon_contracts_for_difference.pdf), European Commission, DG COMP. CCfD auction design; the premium tenor and €30–50/tCO₂ band.
- **`cbam_reg`** — [Regulation (EU) 2023/956 establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2023/956/oj), EUR-Lex. The 2023 free-allocation phase-out factors the law2023 vintage encodes.
- **`ets_dir`** — [Directive (EU) 2023/959 amending Directive 2003/87/EC (EU ETS revision)](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2023/959/oj), EUR-Lex. Product benchmarks and the free-allocation architecture the phase-out applies to.
- **`com2026_616`** — *COM(2026) 616 — reintroduction of a free-allocation floor*, European Commission — **not openly reachable**. Cited by the v12 specification for the 15% floor. The mechanism is confirmed; the annex fixing the floored years has NOT been read. See open item 7.
- **`platts_h2`** — *Platts hydrogen price assessment, Spain, 8 May 2026 — €8.29/kg*, S&P Global Commodity Insights — **not openly reachable**. Licensed market data. Taken from the v12 specification and never confirmed against a subscription. See open item 6.
- **`eurostat_hicp`** — [prc_hicp_aind — HICP annual average rate of change](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/prc_hicp_aind/default/table), Eurostat. Euro-area inflation; grounds the deflator used on the real basis.
- **`eurostat_power`** — [nrg_pc_205 — electricity prices for non-household consumers](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/nrg_pc_205/default/table), Eurostat. Band IE (20–70 GWh/yr), excluding taxes: the closest published band to a steel plant's draw. Puts the floor under the hydrogen price.
- **`eurostat_gas`** — [nrg_pc_203 — gas prices for non-household consumers](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/nrg_pc_203/default/table), Eurostat. Band I5 (1 000 000–3 999 999 GJ/yr), excluding taxes: the closest published band to an integrated works. Sets the grey hydrogen floor, which is the lower of the two and therefore the binding one.
- **`eurostat_ppi`** — [sts_inppd_a — producer prices in industry, annual](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/sts_inppd_a/default/table), Eurostat. Euro-area output prices, 2021 = 100. MIG_CAG (capital goods) restates a EUR 2022 capex figure in today's money; C24 (basic metals) does the same for anything per tonne of product. They have moved in opposite directions since 2022.
- **`eurostat_bs`** — [ei_bsin_q_r2 — business surveys in industry, quarterly](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/ei_bsin_q_r2/default/table), Eurostat. Current level of capacity utilisation, euro area, seasonally adjusted. All-industry rather than steel, so it is a reference point for the load factor, not a measurement of furnace load.
- **`ecb_rates`** — [ECB Data Portal — yield curve and official interest rates](https://data.ecb.europa.eu/), European Central Bank. Series YC/B.U2.EUR.4F.G_N_A.SV_C_YM.SR_10Y (10-year AAA euro-area government spot rate) and FM/B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV (main refinancing rate). Decomposes the 8% hurdle rate into an observed risk-free rate and the premium above it.
- **`iea_h2`** — [Global Hydrogen Review 2024 — GHG emissions of hydrogen and its derivatives](https://www.iea.org/reports/global-hydrogen-review-2024/ghg-emissions-of-hydrogen-and-its-derivatives), International Energy Agency. Unabated hydrogen from natural gas at 10–12 kgCO₂e/kg once upstream methane is counted. Refuses automated clients (403); opens in a browser.
- **`appendix_a`** — *v12 specification, Appendix A*, internal — **not openly reachable**. The build's numerical reference. Sections cited inline. The MATLAB implementation it describes (timing_model.m) was never available.

---

**A standing caution.** NPV, `T*`, `T_exp` and the trigger are model
*outputs*. No statistical agency publishes them and none ever will — only
inputs can be sourced. `T_rel = 2032` is likewise an output, not a fact
about any named plant.
